description: Attach a timestamped activity to an execution, including its category, affected projects and bounded change metadata.

activityId.description: Identifier for the activity within the recorded execution.

category.description: Kind of activity being recorded for this execution.

changeMetadata.description: Bounded metadata describing the activity and its effect.

executionId.description: Execution record ID returned when the execution was registered; associates this call with that execution. Not a session or project ID.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated retry key. Reuse the same key and identical payload only to retry the same mutation; use a new key for a new action.

occurredAt.description: Timestamp of the execution event being recorded.

projectIds.description: Owned projects associated with this execution event.

name: record_agent_execution_activity
title: Record agent execution activity
